pages.name: Overview
pages.title: XAS Lab: X-ray absorption spectroscopy in your browser
pages.description: Pick any chemical formula, find its X-ray absorption edges, plan a sample, compare spectra and follow the quantum workflow behind XAS. Runs in your browser.
pages.ogAlt: XAS Lab overview card with an absorption edge curve

pages.name: Sample
pages.title: Choose a sample and absorption edge
pages.description: Enter any chemical formula and density, then pick the absorbing element and its edge. Uses tabulated X-ray data for every element from hydrogen to californium.
pages.ogAlt: Sample card: choose a formula, an absorbing element and an edge

pages.name: XAS beamline
pages.title: XAS beamline simulator
pages.description: Scan the photon energy across an absorption edge, set the sample thickness and see how many photons reach the detector, using tabulated cross sections.
pages.ogAlt: Beamline card: X-ray source, sample and detector with an absorption curve

pages.name: Spectra studio
pages.title: Spectra studio: compare and fit XAS spectra
pages.description: Save curves, import your own CSV or JSON spectra, normalise them, find the edge, and score a model against data with an energy shift and similarity metrics.
pages.ogAlt: Spectra studio card with overlaid absorption spectra

pages.name: Electronic structure
pages.title: Electronic structure behind an absorption edge
pages.description: See which core to valence transitions shape an absorption edge, and size an active space like the one used in recent quantum computing studies of XAS.
pages.ogAlt: Electronic structure card showing a core electron excited to an empty level

pages.name: Quantum dynamics
pages.title: Quantum dynamics: from time signal to spectrum
pages.description: Kick a ground state with a dipole operator, evolve it in time and Fourier transform the signal into a spectrum. Load your own Hamiltonian of up to six qubits.
pages.ogAlt: Quantum dynamics card with a time signal turning into spectral peaks

pages.name: Experiments
pages.title: Ready-made XAS experiments
pages.description: Open guided experiments in one click, from lithium charge balance to scans across an absorption edge, and save or share your settings as a link or a file.
pages.ogAlt: Experiments card listing guided XAS experiments

pages.name: Methods & validation
pages.title: Methods, data sources and validation
pages.description: The equations, data sources, sanity checks and arXiv papers behind the lab, and the claims these teaching models cannot support. Read this before citing results.
pages.ogAlt: Methods card listing equations, data sources and checks
